end.summary:
- Practised identifying cube, cuboid, cylinder, cone and sphere.
- Child identified pencil, rolling pin and gas cylinder as cylinders.
- Child described cylinder as having circular ends and a curved surface.
- Child identified a cube and later identified a book as a cuboid.
- Teach-back was not passed; no misconceptions were recorded.
end.parentNote: Asha practised naming 3D shapes through familiar objects and drawing requests. Ishita described cylinder features and gave examples such as a pencil, rolling pin and gas cylinder; they also identified a book as a cuboid. The game changed shapes before the requested cuboid drawing was shown, so the activity was not completed. At home, ask Ishita to find and name one cube, cuboid, cylinder, cone and sphere, using pictures or household objects.
